integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect external platforms to publish your resources directly from Preach.

wordpress.title: WordPress
wordpress.description: Publish posts directly from your generated resources.
wordpress.appPasswordHint: Generate an application password in WP admin → Profile → Application Passwords.
wordpress.defaultStatusHint: Draft is safer — review in WP before going live.
wordpress.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect WordPress? You'll need to reconnect to publish again.

comingSoon.mailchimp: Send your devotionals or sermons as a newsletter.
comingSoon.substack: Publish your reflections in your weekly bulletin.

manuscriptStyle.title: Manuscript style
manuscriptStyle.description: How the prose of your sermons is written: how much to develop each idea and what to avoid. It is used when writing a section and when generating the full draft.
manuscriptStyle.usingSystem: You are using the system style.
manuscriptStyle.usingOwn: You are using your own style.
manuscriptStyle.register: The Spanish register (neutral Latin American, no voseo or vosotros) always applies and is not edited here.
manuscriptStyle.saveHint: It is saved with “Guardar Cambios” below.

consent.title: Connect {{cliente}}
consent.subtitle: {{cliente}} wants to read your library and your papers in Dos Filos Preach.
consent.permSearch: Search topics and passages in your books and in the shared public-domain library.
consent.permRead: Read whole sheets of your books, up to 60 per book per day.
consent.permWorks: See your papers, their sources and requirements, and the catalog of recommended works.
consent.cannot: It cannot write, change or delete anything. You can disconnect it anytime in Settings › Integrations.
consent.expired: This request expired or was already used. Connect again from the app.
consent.missing: The connection request is missing. Connect again from the app.
consent.loginBody: An app wants to read your library. Sign in and you'll come back here to decide.
consent.failed: It could not be completed. Try again.
consent.warning: Approve only if you just connected {{cliente}} yourself and {{destino}} is that app's site. If you don't recognize this request, don't allow it.

connections.revokeConfirm: It will stop being able to read your library immediately.
connections.loadFailed: The connections could not be loaded.
